newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks seen moving up ahead of weekend.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks seen moving up ahead of weekend.

text.p: Shares on the Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) are expected to move higher ahead of the two-day weekend on retail and institutional buying, brokers said on Thursday.
"Institutional buying is expected as many blue chips have become very attractive price-wise. Return of institutions may also encourage retail investors," said broker Moshtaque Ahmed.
Gains by engineering and cement scrips might give the market a boost, brokers said.
On Wednesday, the Dhaka Stock Exchange all-share price index gained 13.09 points, or 1.19 percent, at 1,110.46 on turnover of 56.5 million taka.
